noAccess.title: You cannot open Time & action
noAccess.body: Time & action is for the people who plan: your role does not read the planning (planning.view). Ask your administrator.

page.truncated: Only the 400 open orders with the earliest promise dates are shown: search for an order to find the others.

live.offline: Offline: what changes is not shown until the connection is back

gates.title: Waiting on a gate
gates.purpose: Orders that cannot start because a gate is not passed: the planning board holds their work orders until the gate is passed or someone starts before it with a reason.
gates.error: Couldn't load waiting on a gate

hint.SAMPLE: Orders waiting for a sample or the pre-production sample to be approved
hint.LEATHER_NOT_RECEIVED: Orders waiting on the leather with no leather lot reserved for them yet
hint.LEATHER_NOT_PASSED: Orders whose reserved leather is not released by quality yet
hint.TRIMS: Orders waiting for their trims to come in
hint.OTHER: Orders waiting on the lab or a gate of their own

calendar.title: Milestones

purpose.calendar: Milestones by their target date: open a day to see its milestones.
purpose.list: Every milestone of the open orders, with its target, what happened and how late.
purpose.orders: One row per order: its milestones as dots, what it waits on, the next one.

calendar.label: Milestones by target date
calendar.emptyMonth: No milestones in this period. Pick another month, or a day.
calendar.pick: Open a day to see its milestones.

kindHint.SAMPLE_APPROVED: Passes by itself when the sample round it names is approved.
kindHint.LEATHER_APPROVED: Passes by itself when every leather lot reserved for the order is released by quality.
kindHint.TRIMS_IN: Marked done when the trims are in.
kindHint.PP_SAMPLE: Passes by itself when the pre-production round it names is approved.
kindHint.LAB_PASSED: Marked done when the lab results are in and passed.
kindHint.OTHER: Say what it is: marked done by hand.

milestoneKind.START: Follows the planning board and the work orders
milestoneKind.SHIP: Follows the promise date and the shipments

row.orderNewTab: Open order {order} in a new tab
row.orderNewTabShort: Open the order in a new tab
row.openHint: Mark done, start before the gate, change it

empty.body: Add a gate to an order to plan what must be true before its work may start.

noMatch.title: Nothing matches
noMatch.body: No milestone matches the search or the tile pressed.

keys.months: The month before or after (the calendar)

dialog.title: {name} · {order}

gone.title: Milestone not found
gone.body: This milestone is not among the open orders any more (the gate was removed, or the order shipped or closed).

follows.START: The earliest bar of the order's production work orders on the planning board (target) and the first of them that started (actual); a sample or a repair work order never counts.
follows.SHIP: The order's promise date (target) and the first shipment that left (actual).

dialog.holds_one: While it waits, the planning board holds {count} work order of {order}.
dialog.holds_other: While it waits, the planning board holds {count} work orders of {order}.
dialog.holdsNone: While it waits, the planning board will hold the work orders of {order}.
dialog.holdsHow: Mark it done when it is true, or let the work start before it with a reason (someone other than its planner).
dialog.opened: Passed: the work orders of {order} may be planned.
dialog.openedEarly: Started before the gate: the work orders of {order} may be planned; the gate still waits to be passed.

leather.NOT_RECEIVED: No leather lot reserved for the order yet
leather.NOT_PASSED: Reserved, not all released by quality yet
leather.PASSED: Every leather lot reserved for the order is released

form.subtitle: Order {order} · {customer}
form.noOrders: No open order whose gates you may keep.
form.label: What it is
form.targetHint: By when it should be passed (optional).
form.roundHint: The round whose approval passes it (optional): a round of the order's styles for its customer, or internal.
form.roundHintPp: The pre-production round whose approval passes it (optional).
form.ownerHint: Who owns the gate: they may not start the work before it themselves.
form.choicesFailed: Couldn't load the rounds and planners: the gate can be saved without them.

pass.opens: Once passed, the order's work orders may be planned on the board.

start.subtitle: Order {order}
start.why: The order's work waits on this gate: starting before it lets the planning board place its work orders now. The gate still waits to be passed.
start.reason: Why it starts before the gate
start.reasonHint: {min} to {max} characters: what makes it safe to start now.
start.audit: Recorded on the gate with your name, the time and the reason. Only someone who is neither the gate's planner nor the person who added it may do this.

remove.title: Remove the gate {name} of {order}?
remove.what: The gate is removed from the order; nothing else changes.
remove.frees_one: The planning board stops holding {count} work order for it.
remove.frees_other: The planning board stops holding {count} work orders for it.
remove.nothingHeld: No work order of the order waits on it now.

notice.addedPassed: Gate added: its sample round is approved already, so it is passed.
notice.started_one: Started before the gate: the order's work orders may be planned.
notice.started_other: Started before {count} gates: the order's work orders may be planned.

milestones.manage: Keeping an order's gates needs the right to keep gates (a planner or a production manager).
milestones.override: Starting before a gate needs a role that may let work start early (a production manager), and someone other than the gate's planner.

planning.view: Your role does not read the planning.

held.notAGate: Production start and ship follow the board and the shipments: only a gate is marked done.
held.reasonShort: Say why in at least {min} characters.

refusal.ORDER_CLOSED: The order is shipped, closed or cancelled: its gates are kept as they are.
refusal.GATE_EXISTS: The order already has a gate of this kind: change that one.
refusal.LABEL_NEEDED: Say what the gate is: a gate of kind Other needs its words.
refusal.ROUND_ONLY_SAMPLE: Only a sample gate names a sample round.
refusal.ROUND_NOT_OF_ORDER: That sample round is not one of the order's styles for its customer, or it was cancelled.
refusal.ROUND_KIND: A pre-production sample gate waits for a pre-production round.
refusal.ROUND_NOT_APPROVED: It waits for its sample round to be approved: it passes by itself then.
refusal.STARTED_BEFORE: The work started before this gate already.
refusal.OWN_GATE: You are this gate's planner or added it: someone else must let the work start before it.
refusal.FUTURE_DAY: A gate is passed today or on a day before, not on a day to come.
refusal.KEPT: A gate that was passed or started before is kept.
refusal.OWNER_NOT_ALLOWED: That person may not keep this order's gates.
refusal.changed: Someone changed it meanwhile: it was read again, try once more.
refusal.forbidden: Your role may not do this for this order's company or customer.
refusal.notFound: Not found: it was removed meanwhile.
refusal.reason: Say why it starts before the gate.
refusal.invalid: Something in the form is not valid: check it and try again.
refusal.offline: The connection is gone: nothing was saved. Try again once you are back online.
refusal.failed: It could not be saved: try again.

error.offline: The connection is gone: try again once you are back online.
error.forbidden: Your role does not read the planning of this company.
error.failed: Something went wrong reading the orders: try again.
